title: Integer group determinants for abelian groups of order 24
summary: We determine the integer group determinant sets for $C_{24}$, $C_2\times C_{12}$ and $C_2^2\times C_6$, the three abelian groups of order $24$. Character factorization expresses each determinant as a product of cyclotomic norms, whose components must satisfy integral compatibility conditions. The classifications are constructive and reduce each nonzero signed integer to valuation conditions at $2$ and $3$ and a finite test on its remaining prime factors.
